Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Marketing managers annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Marketing Managers ($175,850). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $175,850, Chicago $165,340, Austin $164,920. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Marketing managers?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Marketing Managers (17,400 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 17,400, Austin 7,170, Seattle 6,720. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Marketing managers most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Austin has the highest published location quotient (2.18). Published LQs: Austin 2.18, Chicago 1.52, Seattle 1.27.

What is the hourly median for Marketing managers in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $79.29; Chicago $79.49; Seattle $84.55. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
